purpose: Teach: 終る/顧み/ためらい/程遠い/まるっきり/ひとたび/きまり/だいじょうぶ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お絵描きが終ると、メイ姉さんと公園に行きましょうね
lines.en: Sho, once you finish your drawing, let's go to the park together, okay?
lines.style: Warm invitation. Gentle, unhurried pace. Opens with his name as a small anchor. Slight lift at the end—not a question, but an invitation with space in it. Voice settles low and patient.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんとの思い出を顧みる時、温かい気持ちになるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis… when I remember Grandpa, it makes me feel warm inside.
lines.style: Soft, genuine. A child's careful sincerity—he's thought about this. No performance. Slight pause before 'warm inside,' like he's finding the right feeling. Small voice, steady.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんも、絵を始めるのにためらいがあったのよ
lines.en: Sho, I also felt uncertain when I first started drawing.
lines.style: Thoughtful, turned inward. She's offering something honest. Quiet, almost to herself at first, then a small breath like she's deciding to say it out loud. Warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、メイ姉さんの絵には程遠いよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm nowhere near as good as you are.
lines.style: Wry observation from a perceptive child. Not self-pitying—just stating fact as he sees it. Slight dry humor underneath. Quick, matter-of-fact, with a hint of admiration he doesn't quite realize he's showing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんはまるっきり泣かない人なのよ
lines.en: Sho, I'm not the kind of person who cries easily.
lines.style: Reflective statement, almost musing. She's sharing something about herself. Quiet confidence underneath—not boasting, just fact. Slight sadness around the edges. Measured delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ひとたび絵を描き始めると止まらないよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, once I start drawing, I can't stop.
lines.style: Eager, almost breathless discovery. A child finding something he loves. Quick pace, animated but still his small, genuine voice. Wonder and excitement that he can't quite contain.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お家のきまりは守りましょうね
lines.en: Sho, you need to follow the rules at home, okay?
lines.style: Gentle but clear direction. She's being the older one here—caring, not commanding. Slight warmth still present, but firmer ground underneath. A natural boundary, kindly set.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、だいじょうぶ、一人で帰れるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm okay—I can get home by myself.
lines.style: Small pride in his voice. He's announcing something he's figured out. Quiet but certain. No doubt, no seeking approval—just stating what he knows to be true about himself. Slight lift of independence.
